bboxNote: St Albans, UK ~6 x 6 km centred on 51.75153/-0.32567 (owner experiment 2026-07-18). Covers the built-up city: cathedral/centre (~-0.34), Verulamium Park west edge (~-0.365), Marshalswick NE. grid 6 keeps cell size ~1.0x1.0 km (same streaming granularity as dnipro). bbox = [west,south,east,north] deg. The runtime mask extent for the VARIANT comes from ENRICHED.variantBboxes in src/components/globe/tuning.ts and MUST match this (mask extent == enriched extent, or they overlap/gap).

buildings.buildingsNote: Extruder-only block (bake.mjs; unused by bake-osm2world.mjs) — kept so a classic bake of the same box is one command. UK town defaults: 2-storey brick housing dominates (defaultHeightM 7), pitched roofs steeper than the Dnipro mix (roofPitch 0.5).

vegetation.vegetationNote: Same Slice-3 scatter as dnipro (OSM natural=tree points + tree_row sampling + seeded scatter over wood/forest/park polygons). 60000 cap is generous for a 6x6 km box (the original 7.4x8.9 km Dnipro box hit 24,714 under the same cap).

exclusion.polygonsNote: No per-site polygons — the built-in sensitive-tag blocklist (scripts/bake/lib/exclusion.mjs DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_TAGS: military/substation/plant tags) still applies everywhere, which is prudent and cheap even outside the C6 wartime context.
